data.title: An Analyst Who Expects One More Big Drop Still Sees Bitcoin Reaching $2 Million. Can BTC Rise 26 Times From $75,000?
data.description: Beth Kindig warns another sharp selloff is coming, yet she still holds a seven-figure target for Bitcoin. The math behind that call hinges on one deadline, and ETF outflows and a rising dollar are already testing it.
